questions.q_en: Find the angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock when the time is 36 minutes past 2.
questions.solution_en:
36 minutes past 2 means 2:36

The angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock when the time is 2:36 can be calculated by using the formula -

Angle = |M - 30H|

Where, M = Minutes, H = Hours

M = 36, H = 2

Angle = | X 36 - 30 X 2|

= |198 - 60|

= |138|

Angle = 138

Which of the following interchange of signs would make the given equation correct?

17 - 5 x 146 ÷ 2 + 1 = 13
questions.solution_en:
Option (a) If signs ÷ and x are interchanged, then the equation will be:

17 - 5 ÷ 146 x 2 + 1

= 17 - 0.06 + 1

= 18 - 0.06

= 17.94

So, option (a) is incorrect.

Option (b) If signs + and - are interchanged, then the equation will be:

17 + 5 x 146 ÷ 2 - 1

= 17 + 365 - 1

= 382 - 1

= 381

So, option (b) is incorrect.

Option (c) If signs - and x are interchanged, then the equation will be:

17 x 5 - 146 ÷ 2 + 1

= 85 - 73 + 1

= 86 - 73

= 13

So, option (c) is correct.

Option (d) If signs + and x are interchanged, then the equation will be:

17 - 5 + 146 ÷ 2 x 1

= 17 - 5 + 73

= 90 - 5

= 85

So, option (d) is incorrect.

questions.q_en: Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows with 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons. In Row II - 6, 7, 8 and 9 are seated and all of them are facing north. 1 and 2 are not seated at the extreme ends and 1 sits to the immediate left of 2. 9 and 7 sit opposite 1 and 2 and 7 sits exactly opposite 1. 7 is not the immediate neighbor of 6. Who sits at the extreme right corner of Row II facing north?
questions.solution_en:
1 and 2 are not seated at the extreme ends and 1 sits to the immediate left of 2.

9 and 7 sit opposite 1 and 2 and 7 sits exactly opposite 1. Which means 9 will sit directly opposite to 2.

7 is not the immediate neighbour of 6. Which means 6 will sit at the extreme left corner and 8 will sit at extreme right corner. Also, 3 and 4 will sit the extreme corners in row I but the order is not given.

From the above arrangement, we can clearly say that 8 sits at the extreme right corner of row II facing north.
